title: Kamishiro Rui — Beastly Madness〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, let's GO GO GO to the next area♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu's having so much fun guiding them around.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She already seemed to know them and must have really wanted to show them this place.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But you're not having a bad time yourself, are you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well... I suppose not...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui! Nene! Hurry up or you'll get left behind!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, alright.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. We rarely get this sort of chance,
so we should probably make the most of it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our next attraction is the Phoenix Coaster...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's so tall... And it looks really fast...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed it does! The Go! Go! Phenny! coaster we rode earlier is very family-oriented, but this one is geared more towards thrill-seeking youngsters!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since its upgrade, it's become one of the biggest draws for this park!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hang on, that's pretty much exactly what the pamphlet for this place said...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hnng...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Allow me to elaborate further...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The lights on the coaster change with each season.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And since it's much taller than the Phenny coaster, the view from the top is supposed to be spectacular, especially at night.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The camera at the peak is set up so that it captures the best possible angle and background as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What's more, photos are taken not only from the front, but also from behind as you descend for a more dynamic image.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's how you do it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You... You know your stuff, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Each of this park's attractions has its own charm.
I researched them all as references for later.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was wondering what Tsukasa's troupe would be like, but they all seem much more capable than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. Rui probably does a lot to keep Tsukasa's crazy ideas in check too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see. Kamishiro must really understand him then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Next is... Ah, of course! We should show you some interesting locations alongside the rides and attractions!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I've got this☆ Let me take over, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
If you stroll down to the right of this road,
you'll find a quiet little path with a bench.
It's a lovely spot to sit down and relax♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe... And let's not forget the Phenny monument that's cleverly placed at the beginning of the path.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, so it's a spot for taking pictures but a little tucked away?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it's quite photogenic.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the best part is how it makes for such great cover.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's the perfect spot to hide from the park's security guards. They never look behind the monument.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Umm, so...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, right! It's because Rui kept getting in trouble with the guards for doing shows in the park without permission♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh yeah, he used to do that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why'd you pick this theme park for that anyway, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I was drawn here simply by how many visitors the park attracts.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Emu and the others don't seem bothered by it, so maybe it's not as strange as it seems?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uhh, sure...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! Next, we have a ride that takes you through a torrential downpour and gale-force winds!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That is a good one, and very realistic too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Although, if you were to ask me, it lacks lightning bolts like the ones we featured in one of our shows.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: L-Lightning...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I remember that... I was SHOCKED that we actually did that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It was sooo amazing!
All ZINGY ZING and ZAP ZAP ZAP!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Not only did it give me terrible frizz,
some of my hair actually got singed...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, this isn't a joke? It really happened?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Rui's really good at coming up with stage effects♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And he makes cool stuff like Robo-Nene and other robots!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki, Shiho, & Honami
rows.Line: R-Robots?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. You'll see some at today's show.
Maybe you can see them afterwards as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: W-We'll be looking forward to it...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It sounds just... Unbelievable, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is all just going way over my head...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha... Well, I guess in the end, he is someone that can actually make shows really happen with my brother.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...  And maybe a little out of the ordinary in this case is just par for the course.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. They all look like they're having fun,
so I guess that's what matters!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!
